kind: Source-format clarification, not a change to primary QC thresholds or effect estimators
nominal_rule_used_by_frozen_cache: Waveform CSV is a constant-interval array with missing value rows retained. First Time=0 and second Time=sampling interval; t[i]=i*interval. This is supported by the API's documented encoding, not imputation of missing measurement values.
sdk_note: The current legacy CSV loader can resample values to a length determined from the endpoint; nominal-grid feature reproduction and any SDK-resampling sensitivity must be labelled separately.
version_boundary: Current official load_case uses packed .vital v1.0.1 and comments that old per-track CSV can have a per-case constant time shift. This run preserves and hashes the supplied legacy CSV-based inputs, does not migrate dataset versions and does not claim independent validation of absolute clinical event times against packed .vital.
required_reporting: Preserve the literal-time diagnostic, the authoritative encoding explanation and the independent nominal-grid feature check. Do not claim that a missing per-row Time is missing waveform data. Do not claim full-record timestamp verification.
